message.content: Perfect! The output looks correct. Now I need to save the jq command to `/app/cmd.sh` and the arguments to `/app/jq_args.yaml`:

function.name: str_replace_editor

extras.diff:
--- /app/cmd.sh
+++ /app/cmd.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+jq '[.[] | select(.status == "active") | {
+  user_id: .id,
+  username: .username,
+  email: .email,
+  last_login: (.last_login | split("T")[0]),
+  role_count: (.roles | length),
+  primary_role: (if (.roles | length) > 0 then .roles[0] else null end)
+} ] | sort_by(.username)' --indent 2 /app/users.json > /app/active_users_report.json
